description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for managing user notifications in a backend system, including fetching, marking as read, creating, and updating notifications.

methods.name: GET /notifications
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve notifications for a user, with optional filter for unread only.

methods.name: PATCH /notifications/:notificationId/read
methods.description: Endpoint to mark a specific notification as read.

methods.name: PATCH /notifications/read-all
methods.description: Endpoint to mark all unread notifications as read for the user.

methods.name: POST /notifications
methods.description: Endpoint for admins or users to create a new notification for a user.
